name: Foundry
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The voxel factory-building game: mine, automate production lines and research in an infinite world. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Wine and keeps it updated.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Foundry. Installs or updates the Windows dedicated server (Steam app
# 2915550) with SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Worlds (serverfiles), mods
# and App.cfg are never touched, once written.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-2915550}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The settings file the server reads (App.cfg): the game's own template,
# written once; the Panel sets its keys at every start.
if [ ! -f App.cfg ]; then
    cat > App.cfg <<'CFG'
server_name=A Foundry server
server_password=
server_world_name=MyFoundry
server_max_players=32
server_port=3724
server_query_port=27015
server_is_public=true
pause_server_when_empty=true
autosave_interval=300
map_seed=42938743982
server_persistent_data_override_folder=/home/container/serverfiles
CFG
fi
mkdir -p serverfiles Mods
echo "Installed Foundry build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: World
variables.description: The world to load, or create when there's none by that name.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: true lists the server in the Steam server list.

variables.name: Pause when empty
variables.description: true pauses the world while nobody is on.

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in seconds.

variables.name: Map seed
variables.description: The seed a new world is generated from.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Virtual display
variables.description: The server needs a display, so the image starts a virtual one.

variables.name: Wine components
variables.description: What Wine installs before the first start.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.

variables.name: Windows install
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Wine.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: What Wine logs; -all keeps its messages out of the console.
